label: A coup and confusion in China's own camp, so they turn on themselves
description: China having a coup in its camp among the military and around its leader, with so much confusion that they turn on themselves as the army did in the Gideon account, so that they do not take Taiwan or interfere with South Korea and Japan. Prayed for rather than announced, but a coup attempt in Beijing would be unmistakable.
aliases: China will have keep having a coup in their in their camp
there'll be so much confusion that they'll turn on themselves
As they try to come against the people, they turn on themselves

label: The blood moon falls over Hawaii and Asia, and it represents war
description: A total lunar eclipse and blood moon whose totality runs from the West Coast over Hawaii and Asia rather than over Iran, which he reads as a sign of war placed over the region where he expects the next conflict, prompting caution over Hawaii, Asia and Australia. The eclipse itself is astronomical fact; the claim is the meaning and the placing.
aliases: represents war
It's seen over Asia. It's seen over Hawaii
I had great caution concerning Hawaii

label: A mass attack at the Hawaii mall, with a van used as the weapon
description: Three men seen at a mall in Hawaii near the statue with the flower lei and the surfboard, across from the designer shops, planning a mass casualty event using a van as a weapon against people, which he first saw around Christmas, chosen to show they have infiltrated every area of the nation, with the same seen on the Las Vegas strip by the named hotels and casino. The location is specific enough to fail cleanly.
aliases: I saw in that that circle a mass pow pow
the man with the you put the flowers on his neck and he has the surfboard
it was a van to use it as a weapon against the people

label: Do not pray the news, because if you are praying the news you are behind
description: His stated standard: they do not pray the news, and anyone praying the news is already behind, because the Lord shows them what is coming well in advance and they pray weeks ahead into the future rather than into the past or present. He offers the drones, the missile attacks, Tel Aviv and Taiwan as the examples. It is the test he sets himself, and it can be checked directly against the recordings, since a large part of each broadcast is spent reading the day's news back as confirmation.
aliases: Remind them don't pray the news
If you're praying the news, you're behind
We're praying into the future

label: A superhighway above, and believers translated from place to place
description: A superhighway above them with translations, so that those walking with the Father will be in one place and then another, ministering to people, through a door long closed to the body of Christ that is about to open and flood wide the gates. Bodily translation is a claim that would be unmistakable if anyone demonstrated it.
aliases: the super highway above us with with translations
you're going to be here and we're going to be there
I'm going to open this door and it's going to flood wide the gates

label: A conservative Mexican leader who looks like Antonio Banderas
description: The Mexican president removed and a great new conservative leader rising who looks like the actor Antonio Banderas, with the drug cartel dealt with, prayed for alongside a change of Cuban leadership that he says could happen at the same time. Giving a physical likeness is unusual for him and makes the claim recognisable.
aliases: this man that I saw looks like Antonio Banderas
a great new leader that's conservative to rise up in Mexico
for the drug cartel to be dealt with

label: He briefed people of authority about Cuba and the border smuggling
description: He says he told people of authority that day what he saw concerning Cuba and the smuggling in certain towns on the border, and believes they now have enough information that it will be heard in the news one day. A claim about his own contacts rather than about events, and one that would be settled by any such disclosure.
aliases: I told people of authority today about what I saw concerning Cuba
the smuggling in these certain towns on the border
we will hear it in the news one day
